review:
Move Symbols to layer 5

The layers in between shift by one, and every key that switches layers is updated to match.

Layer 2: layer 2 → 1
Layer 3: layer 3 → 2
Layer 4: layer 4 → 3
Layer 5: layer 5 → 4
Symbols: layer 1 → 5
Updates 3 layer keys so they still reach the same layers.

This keyboard doesn't report its default layer, so layer 0 and every layer a DF or PDF key selects (0) keep their numbers.

When more than one layer is on, the highest-numbered one wins, so a move can change which layer's keys come through.

This changes the offline layout.
